links.outcome: Whether continuous evaluation frameworks reveal performance differences missed by single time point metrics such as AUROC
links.effect: Models with high AUROC showed markedly different performance under continuous evaluation across both datasets; no numbers reported in the abstract.
links.quote: Across both datasets, models with high AUROC demonstrate markedly different performance when continuously evaluated.

unlisted_practices: Continuous zone-based, AMOC-based, and notification-based retrospective evaluation of continuously running predictive models

screen.reason: Empirical study developing and testing continuous retrospective evaluation frameworks for clinical risk models (sepsis) to simulate real-world alerting behavior compared to standard static evaluation metrics.
